# Maheera fonts for a host page

Generated by `node test/embed/build-panel.mjs --host-kit <dir>` in rfim/maheera from `site/shared/fonts.css`.
Copy this folder into your app (for example `vendor/maheera-fonts/`) and link it in the page that shows
`<maheera-panel>`:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/vendor/maheera-fonts/fonts.css">
```

The panel then sets its text in Inter, as the Maheera operator app does. Without it the panel falls back to
the system font and still fits. Everything is self-hosted: no font CDN. Licences: `fonts/OFL-*.txt`.
